AnnotationDescription: Observation : Reduced growth along one irrigation line, running the length of the row. Likely Cause : Suspected malfunction in the drip line along that row. Recommendation : Inspect and test the drip line for blockages or damage.

Observation : A cluster of stunted plants with curled leaves near the access track. Likely Cause : Aphid pressure carrying virus in from the weedy field edge. Recommendation : Scout under the leaves and spot-spray if aphids are present, and clear the weeds along the track.

Observation : Pale, uneven canopy colour through the middle of the block compared with the rest of the field. Likely Cause : Nitrogen running short as the crop reaches peak demand. Recommendation : Take a leaf-tissue sample to confirm, then top-dress nitrogen on this section.

Observation : A dry, lighter wedge fanning out from one corner of the field. Likely Cause : A blocked or mis-aligned sprinkler leaving this wedge short of water. Recommendation : Check the sprinklers on that span and clear the blocked nozzle before the next set.

Observation : Scattered dark leaf spotting starting on the older, lower leaves in the east block. Likely Cause : Early-stage fungal leaf spot, still limited to the lower canopy. Recommendation : Begin a preventive spray programme and remove the worst-affected lower leaves where practical.

Observation : A small, bright, vigorous patch noticeably greener than the crop around it. Likely Cause : Healthy new growth where the replanted section has established well. Recommendation : No action needed, use this patch as the benchmark for how the rest of the field should look.
